blocks.title: Built-in data structures
blocks.text: Python has built-in data structures for organizing and handling data efficiently: lists, tuples and dictionaries, each with its own features.

blocks.prompt: Name three built-in data structures in Python.

items: Built-in data structures: lists, tuples, dictionaries.
